description: Hand eligibility labels for live ClinicalTrials.gov criteria bullets, for two synthetic profiles. Bullets come from agent.eligibility.split_criteria(criteria_text); 'index' is the position in that list.
conventions: Status means 'does the patient pass this criterion'. For an exclusion, met = the exclusion does not apply.
Conservative: if a careful reader could not decide from the profile's fields, the label is unknown.
A bullet that mixes a decidable part with an undecidable part is unknown, unless a decidable part fails (then not_met).
prior_treatments is the complete treatment history; weeks_ago is the time since the treatment ended.
Performance status, labs, comorbidities, tumor location and size, other cancers, trial participation and current medications are not recorded: unknown.
Each bullet is labeled on its own, even when it is one option of an OR list.
